title: Fixed Two-Wheel Open Log Arch
description: One newly authored whole empty two-wheel forestry log-arch exterior in a fixed parked pose. A tall continuous open arch spans between two large low wheels, leaving a clear under-arch space with no cargo bed or tub. Two forward converging draw rails lead to a transverse handgrip and a short parked support leg. A central short suspension boss and thick open link carry two broad curved tong jaws in a fixed open pose below the arch crown. The entire suspended-load frame, wheels and draw geometry are newly authored, not an old handcart with a pallet removed or a cant-hook on a trolley. One static equipment prop, zero scenes, no log instance. No lifting, skidding, capacity, towing, stability or safe operational function claim.
